monumental.edge: A mobile robot crew handles brick supply, mortar, and placement directly on conventional construction sites.
monumental.summary: Mobile construction robots coordinate bricklaying and material supply, operating as a masonry subcontractor on ordinary building sites.

mytra.edge: Self-moving payload robots navigate a dense 3D storage lattice without dedicated lifts and conveyors.
mytra.summary: Robots move heavy materials through a modular three-dimensional storage lattice, simplifying warehouse storage and retrieval infrastructure.

gecko-robotics.edge: Wall-climbing sensor robots connect dense inspection measurements to operational asset decisions.
gecko-robotics.summary: Wall-climbing robots collect dense industrial inspection data; software connects measurements to maintenance and asset decisions.

anybotics.edge: Legged inspection robots integrate sensing, repeatable routes, and industrial maintenance workflows.
anybotics.summary: Autonomous quadrupeds inspect industrial facilities, combining rugged mobility with visual, thermal, acoustic, and gas sensing.

carbon-robotics.edge: Real-time plant recognition directs lasers at weeds while protecting crops across variable farm conditions.
carbon-robotics.summary: Vision-guided laser systems destroy weeds close to crops, reducing herbicide use and manual weeding in suitable field operations.

exotec.edge: Rack-climbing robots decouple storage capacity from retrieval throughput in a modular warehouse system.
exotec.summary: Rack-climbing robots retrieve goods from dense storage, with coordinated software and stations for scalable warehouse fulfillment.

cmr-surgical.edge: Small separate robotic units and an open surgeon console fit robotic assistance into existing operating rooms.
cmr-surgical.summary: Modular surgeon-controlled robots provide precise instruments and flexible operating-room layouts for minimally invasive surgery.

field-ai.edge: Risk-aware onboard robot software handles uncertain industrial sites without preconfigured maps or routes.
field-ai.summary: Risk-aware autonomy software guides mobile robots through changing industrial sites, collecting inspection and 3D documentation data.
